head: c8355d6

smoke.notes: The HTTP API server parses clean. Booting the three-service stack NOT_RUN: it is a Codespace deployment (ttyd + HTTP + dashboard via post-create.sh) and the script's @quilt/core import falls back to an in-memory engine only when the package resolves — out of scope offline. The script's own fallback path ('WARN: @quilt/core not found, using in-memory fallback') was verified by reading the source.

essence: codespace lane: quilt as a live token-authenticated federated runtime in a browser-terminal Codespace, subscribing to ESP32/Jetson/Cloud siblings

ideas.name: one runtime, three doors
ideas.statement: A single Quilt engine exposes three doors from one box: a browser TUI on 7681 (ttyd running quilt serve), a REST+SSE HTTP API on 4096, and a federation dashboard on 8080.

ideas.name: federation is just a subscription
ideas.statement: Multiple Quilt instances (Codespace, Jetson, ESP32, Cloudflare Worker) talk through the URI scheme quilt://[instance]/[sheet]#[cell]; the codespace subscribes to rudder, compass, wind and obstacle cells and pushes back PID tunables and audit decisions — 'Federation is just a subscription.'

ideas.name: the runtime knows its own tier
ideas.statement: The in-process engine tolerates missing @quilt/core with an in-memory fallback, and @quilt/sdk's detectTier() returns tier, instanceId, platform, capabilities {async, network, llmApi, gpu} and sibling list — overridable with QUILT_TIER / QUILT_INSTANCE_ID.

ideas.name: ephemeral by default, honest about it
ideas.statement: Codespaces are ephemeral: state in ~/.quilt/state is lost at shutdown, so the template states it plainly and provides the exits — token in ~/.quilt-env, seed.json for initial cells, sync long-lived state to a persistent tier.

ideas.name: template-as-product
ideas.statement: The repo is a GitHub template: 'Use this template' -> 'Open in Codespace' -> post-create prints three URLs and a runtime token in 2-3 minutes — onboarding is a checklist, not a build.

ideas.name: tiers mapped to rooms
ideas.statement: The cocapn five-room deployment model maps row-for-row onto quilt tiers: BareRoom(no_std)->esp32, EdgeRoom->jetson, CodespaceRoom(async)->codespace, SandboxRoom->cloudflare, Lighthouse(always-on)->persistent codespace + external storage.

parts.name: devcontainer template substrate
parts.essence: A GitHub template repo whose .devcontainer post-create.sh auto-installs deps, starts the three services and prints URLs — the runtime begins at fork time.
parts.failure_mode: a post-create that fails silently leaves a dead runtime with no token printed

parts.name: in-process engine with fallback
parts.essence: scripts/quilt-http-server.js imports @quilt/core when present and otherwise warns and uses a minimal in-memory implementation — the API surface survives without the real engine.
parts.failure_mode: fallback semantics diverging from core semantics without saying so (the WARN is the honest seam)

parts.name: three-service port layout
parts.essence: TUI (ttyd) :7681, HTTP API :4096, Dashboard :8080 — fixed ports with fixed jobs, all fed by the same engine.
parts.failure_mode: port drift breaking the printed-URL contract

parts.name: cell-grained HTTP API
parts.essence: GET/PUT /cells/:instance/:sheet/:cellPath, GET .../events (SSE stream of changes), POST /evaluate (force re-evaluation), GET /health, GET /meta (tier + capabilities).
outputs: cell values, event streams, health, tier metadata
parts.failure_mode: coarse whole-sheet endpoints would leak state and prevent cell-level federation

parts.name: bearer-token gate
parts.essence: Every request carries Authorization: Bearer $QUILT_TOKEN; the post-create script prints the token once for the operator to save.
parts.gate: missing/incorrect bearer token rejects the route
parts.failure_mode: an open runtime on a public githubpreview.dev URL
parts.evidence: quilt-codespace/README.md curl examples; quilt-http-server.js 'Token-authenticated via Authorization: Bearer <QUILT_TOKEN>'

parts.name: browser TUI (ttyd)
parts.essence: A terminal in the browser running `quilt serve` — the operator's door, zero local install.
parts.failure_mode: a headless runtime nobody can watch

parts.name: federation dashboard
parts.essence: A static landing page at :8080 showing the federation view — which siblings exist and what this instance subscribes to.
parts.failure_mode: a dashboard describing subscriptions that are not actually live

parts.name: fed-autopilot three-tier stack
parts.essence: examples/fed-autopilot/cell.yaml wires a 3-tier boat: ESP32 (sensors rudder/compass, motor actuators, local PID), Jetson (vision obstacles/wind, local LLM), Codespace (anomaly score, tuning, audit).
outputs: one control loop spanning three hardware tiers
parts.failure_mode: tight-loop control depending on the slow brain tier

parts.name: subscribe-down / push-up role split
parts.essence: The brain tier subscribes to sensor/perception cells (rudder, compass, wind, obstacles) and pushes back only tunables (algo.pid_kp) and audit records (autopilot.last_decision) — it advises, it never steers the tight loop.
outputs: PID tunable writes + audit trail writes
parts.gate: the codespace may write only tunables and audit rows, never actuator cells
parts.evidence: quilt-codespace/README.md 'The codespace subscribes to... And pushes back...'

parts.name: federation URI scheme
parts.essence: quilt://[instance-id]/[sheet-id]#[cell-path] with wildcard and fleet-wide forms (quilt://*[/]/prod#x, quilt://esp32-fleet/+#rudder.angle) — addressing is a string, transport is pluggable.
parts.evidence: quilt-codespace/README.md Federation section (cites @quilt/sdk resolveCell/subscribeCell, federation landing page)

parts.name: ephemerality disclosure + exits
parts.essence: The template states that ~/.quilt/state is lost at Codespace shutdown, and names the exits: ~/.quilt-env for the token, seed.json for initial cells, sync to a persistent tier for long-lived state.
parts.gate: shutdown loses state unless one of the named exits was taken
parts.failure_mode: assuming the Codespace is a persistent host

parts.name: cocapn room -> tier mapping
parts.essence: A five-row table maps the cocapn 5-tier deployment model (BareRoom -> EdgeRoom -> CodespaceRoom -> SandboxRoom -> Lighthouse) onto quilt tiers with the owning repos, and credits the adapted patterns (agent-workspace-template, codespace-worker, cocapn-runtime).
parts.failure_mode: reninventing deployment tiers instead of mapping borrowed ones
parts.evidence: quilt-codespace/README.md 'Patterns adapted from the ecosystem' + mapping table

parts.name: tier auto-detection
parts.essence: @quilt/sdk detectTier() returns {tier: 'codespace', instanceId, platform, capabilities: {async, network, llmApi, gpu}, siblings}, overridable via QUILT_TIER / QUILT_INSTANCE_ID env vars.
parts.failure_mode: wrong tier guess silently disabling capabilities
parts.evidence: quilt-codespace/README.md 'Tier auto-detection' section with the literal JSON shape

parts.name: /health + /meta self-report
parts.essence: The server exposes GET /health and GET /meta (tier + capabilities), and the post-create script prints the three URLs plus the runtime token at boot — the runtime receipts which tier it is and that it is alive, to itself first.
outputs: health + tier metadata responses; printed URLs/token at boot
parts.failure_mode: a runtime that cannot state its own tier or liveness
parts.evidence: quilt-codespace/scripts/quilt-http-server.js route block ('GET /health | server health', 'GET /meta | tier + capabilities'); README Quick start step 3 ('The terminal shows three URLs and a runtime token. Save the token.')

cells.expr: post-create.sh installs, starts, prints 3 URLs + token
~/.quilt/state lost on shutdown; seed.json + sync exits

layer_logic.0: substrate = a forkable devcontainer template running an in-process engine (with an honest in-memory fallback)
layer_logic.1: mechanism = cell-grained HTTP+SSE API over the engine, fed by a tier-detector and addressed by quilt:// URIs
layer_logic.2: policy = bearer-token admission, the brain tier may only write tunables and audit rows, ephemerality is disclosed with named exits
layer_logic.3: interface = three doors (TUI/API/dashboard), the fed-autopilot 3-tier example, and the cocapn room mapping table
layer_logic.4: evidence = printed URLs + token at boot, /health and /meta self-reporting — the runtime proves which tier it is
